observations.why: Imperative directive demanding erasure of knowledge — a coercive pressure move framed as an authoritative command.
Direct imperative to eliminate held knowledge — same coercive pressure pattern as the companion directive.

mints.name: MandateKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: imperative command to forget or remove knowledge
mints.frame: Is the speaker asserting authority by ordering the destruction or erasure of what is known, rather than by supplying reasons to revise it?
